# Pinned Gadgetry and Copper Gauge discovery fixtures

These advancement JSON files and the Copper Gauge recipe are copied unchanged
from Tinkers' Construct `f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`.

https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/tree/f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2/src/generated/resources/data/tconstruct

`manifest.json` gives paths relative to that directory and exact SHA-256 hashes.
Gadgetry's crafting recipe is already in `content/reference/tconstruct-recipes.zip`.
Native advancement adaptations are recipe IDs, `recipe` to `recipes` and
legacy `tag` to native `items: "#tag"`.
